Uniswap & Linch is associated with decentralized exchange activity on public blockchains. Uniswap & Linch relies on smart contracts rather than intermediaries to execute trades.

Ribbon Finance is a DeFi protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Ribbon Finance offers automated options vaults that structure yield-generating strategies for users.

OKEx is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange rather than a smart-contract-based DeFi application. OKEx operates through a central company that intermediates trades.

Umbrella Network is a decentralized oracle network that supplies external data to blockchain smart contracts. Umbrella Network is designed to run without a single central intermediary.
